full_translation_en:
Parliamentary Secretariat
Federal Parliament
Kathmandu, Singhdarbar
Urgent Notice Regarding the Convening of the Session of the Federal Parliament

As per the request of the Right Honourable President, Ram Chandra Paudel, in accordance with Article 93, Sub-section (1) of the Constitution of Nepal, I hereby convene the session of the Federal Parliament on Monday, Baishakh 28, 2081 BS at 9:00 AM.

Details:

Place: House of Representatives Hall (Multipurpose Hall), Federal Parliament Building, Singhdarbar.

Date: Monday, Baishakh 28, 2081 BS

Time: 9:00 AM



(Pang Prasad Pandey)
Secretary-General
Federal Parliament Secretariat
Federal Parliament

sections.name: Opening
sections.summary_en: An urgent notice is issued by the Federal Parliament Secretariat, Kathmandu, Singhdarbar, announcing the convening of the Federal Parliament session. The session is called by the Right Honourable President, Ram Chandra Paudel, as per Article 93, Sub-section (1) of the Constitution of Nepal.

sections.name: Details
sections.summary_en: The notice specifies the location as the House of Representatives Hall (Multipurpose Hall) in the Federal Parliament Building, Singhdarbar. The session is scheduled for Monday, Baishakh 28, 2081 BS, at 9:00 AM.

sections.name: Closing
sections.summary_en: The notice is signed by Pang Prasad Pandey, Secretary-General of the Federal Parliament Secretariat.
